## Dryad source

Gutierrez, Hart and Boukhechba (2022), [10.5061/dryad.66t1g1k4j](https://doi.org/10.5061/dryad.66t1g1k4j), CC0 according to deposit metadata. Original ZIP and README are excluded from this GitHub release. The existing Kaggle release separately records its repackaged source files and licenses in [PUBLICATION.md](delivery/kaggle/PUBLICATION.md).

## ENABL3S source

Hu, Blair; Rouse, Elliott; Hargrove, Levi. *Benchmark datasets for bilateral lower limb neuromechanical signals from wearable sensors during unassisted locomotion in able-bodied individuals*, [Figshare version 2, 10.6084/m9.figshare.5362627.v2](https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.5362627.v2). Source license: [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Methods: [Frontiers 2018](https://doi.org/10.3389/frobt.2018.00014); [corrigendum](https://doi.org/10.3389/frobt.2018.00127).

Original participant archives are not included. The download manifest retains their published MD5, sizes and locally computed SHA-256. `reports/enabl3s*` contains derived summaries, source inventories and provenance; `reports/figures/enabl3s*` contains project-generated figures. These ENABL3S-derived artifacts are distributed under CC BY 4.0 with the attribution above. Transformations include selection of bilateral vastus-lateralis walking segments, predefined trimming, amplitude summaries, ratios, and descriptive sensitivity analyses. They are not author-endorsed measurements of clinical impairment. The scripts and original explanatory prose retain MIT.

No participant was newly recruited for this project. No clinical clearance, scientific-priority or author-endorsement claim is made.
